Recommended Products

{% endfor %} {% else %}

Resource exhaustion: Limit the number of tags processed to prevent # potential DoS via extremely long comma-separated lists if len(search_tags) > 100: return "Too many tags provided", 400 conn = get_db_connection() # Parameterized query to prevent SQL Injection placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(search_tags)) query = f''' SELECT p.product_name, p.id FROM products p JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.product_id WHERE t.tag IN ({placeholders}) GROUP BY p.id ''' products_found = conn.execute(query, search_tags).fetchall() results = [] for row in products_found: # Parameterized query to prevent SQL Injection product_tags = conn.execute('SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE product_id = ?', (row['id'],)).fetchall() results.append({ 'name': row['product_name'], 'tags': [t['tag'] for t in product_tags] }) conn.close() # render_template_string automatically escapes variables passed to the template return render_template_string(HTML_TEMPLATE, products=results), 200 except Exception: # Generic error handling to avoid leaking internal details/stack traces return "An internal error occurred", 500 @app.route('/recommender', methods=['POST']) def post_product(): try: #
